US Counties Shapefile

Source: R/county_sf.R
county_sf.Rd

Useful sf object shapefile for US Counties.

Usage

county_sf

Format

An object of class sf (inherits from data.frame) with 3142 rows and 10 columns.

Details


Rows: 3,142
Columns: 10
